prerequisites_for_420: Identify canonical company/tenant identity and explicit owner authority; do not equate employee roles with company offering entitlements.
Perform migration/RLS/tenant-isolation review before offering any company switches.
Define reviewed default entitlements for existing work and audit trail, with safe rollback.
Preserve historical service documents, Jobs, Finance, Safety, staff, equipment and shared CRM even when new-work offering is disabled.
Require independently authenticated, server-enforced company service permissions for new writes, without allowing client UI toggles as authority.
Validate real historical company agreements against a complete company-scoped source before auto-enabling any offering.
authority_boundary: Information-only dated snapshot, not live detection, company authorization, tenant isolation certification, new service enablement, customer migration, or Finance/Jobs action.
